data_description.id: Used in scripts. You can only send to a category without subcategories or to a subcategory.
data_description.parent: Leave empty for a regular category. A category with subcategories becomes a group: it cannot be sent to and only holds shared settings for its subcategories.
data_description.prefix: Text without brackets. "Power" + "Emergency" gives [Power][Emergency] at the start of the title. With no title, the prefix itself becomes the title.
data_description.default: "As in general": each user configures it. "Off": nobody gets it until a user explicitly turns it on.
data_description.service: A service category (for example, for the developer) is hidden from users on the settings page; only admins see it.
